command: pre-registration: L4 continual store of created role tokens, H1-H5, before any fit / rollout / read

metrics.H1: scratch O+G role pair (n 2 each) non-inferior to M1 whole-task token (n 4) at margin 0.05 on 29 dev tasks; one-sided p = share of two-level cluster-bootstrap differences <= -0.05 (B 10000)
metrics.H2: reuse@canonical partner > zs on the 13 canonical headroom targets: more successes + exact two-sided sign test
metrics.H3: complete@partner > causal@partner (reused tokens removed) on the 13 targets: same test
metrics.H4: init@partner at 200 steps > scratch at 200 steps on the 13 targets: same test
metrics.H5: stream FWT > 0 (late vs early, 16 tasks, orders A/B pooled; same test) AND routed damage >= -0.01 (dev tasks and M1's 10 training cells, both orders) AND final store bytes <= 1/100 of 29 per-task LoRAs
metrics.disclosure: M1 and FM per-task success on fresh_m1 read before (headroom rule); one python3-prefixed command refused on the login node before running
metrics.secondary: per-arm success (combination / part); complete vs scratch non-inferiority (unadjusted); reuse vs zs on all pairs; cross-scene same-text reuse; budget-to-threshold (scratch 50/200/1000, init 50/200); stream choices, fits, bytes-vs-parts, GPU-s per arrival vs LoRA, exceptions
metrics.stream_rule: route by parts (scene, role, items contained); practice zs + cover 5 eps each (fresh_l4p); best >= 3/5 passes (ties zs < cover); else complete (cover frozen, new tokens for uncovered items) if the cover is non-empty and >= zs on practice, else scratch; practice it; serve the best (ties zs < cover < fitted); store new tokens as parts (held keys -> exception); exception when part routing differs from the choice
metrics.written_before: any L4 fit, rollout or read
